final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT o.timespan AS ts, AVG(f.rebrate * 1.0 / f.feerate) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink GROUP BY o.timespan), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.ts AS ts, s1.avg_ratio AS avg_ratio, s1.cnt AS cnt, s1.cnt - s2.avg_cnt AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.cnt > s2.avg_cnt) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio), SUM(cnt), AVG(diff) FROM s3
